validation_notes: The right side of the chart shows a strong, steep uptrend from ~320 to ~382, followed by a sharp reversal down to ~357 and consolidation around 357-365. This is not a converging triangle structure - there's no clear flat or rising support line with a flat/falling resistance line forming a narrowing wedge. Instead it looks like a sharp rally into a blow-off top with subsequent pullback. The last few candles (357-365 range) are too few (only ~5-6 candles) to establish two clearly touched trendlines converging toward an apex. The algorithm likely mistook the rising swing lows during the uptrend (320->335->357) as ascending triangle support, but there's no corresponding flat resistance - price kept making higher highs all the way to 382, which is characteristic of a trend, not a triangle. After the peak, price dropped sharply rather than consolidating within converging boundaries, which contradicts an ascending triangle setup (which would expect compression before breakout, not after a parabolic top).
